shots.narration: ब्रह्मा ने यह पूरा ब्रह्मांड रचा
shots.meaning: Brahma is introduced as the creator of the entire universe.
shots.why: A wide, deep frame shows his scale: hazy far mountains, a tree and pillar mid, a dark shrub near; he opens his arms on 'रचा' as worlds appear.

camera.motivation: slow push-in builds awe as creation is named

layers.contents: two snow mountains and a cloud, hazy lavender
a banyan left, a gold pillar right

effects.meaning: light of creation falling on him
the universe ringing out from his gesture

shots.narration: फिर भी उनकी पूजा कोई क्यों नहीं करता
shots.meaning: The riddle: despite creating everything, no one worships him.
shots.why: The warm world turns to a red storm on 'पूजा' and Brahma turns away in sorrow: the loss of worship is shown, not told.

camera.motivation: pull-out isolates him as the question lands

layers.contents: storm clouds drawn by the background
dark rocks in both bottom corners
